misconception.myth: Discounting every bond cash flow with a single flat yield to maturity accurately reflects market pricing.
misconception.reality: Each cash flow must be discounted at the specific zero rate matching its exact payment maturity to avoid arbitrage.

causalChain.condition: Observed market prices of Treasury bills and coupon bonds across multiple maturities
causalChain.action: Strip known prior coupon cash flows recursively using previously calculated zero discount factors
causalChain.mechanism: Isolate the final principal and coupon cash flow to solve directly for the next unknown zero rate
causalChain.result: Construct a continuous, arbitrage-free spot zero curve across all maturities
causalChain.consequence: Enables exact valuation of multi-period corporate bonds, interest rate swaps, and complex derivatives
